description: This Lua source file contains various test functions designed to provoke errors with specific constraints, such as string length, memory usage, instruction length, identifier size, constants, and index tables. The functions seem to test the robustness of the Lua interpreter in handling extreme or invalid input scenarios.

methods.name: teststring
methods.description: Tests string length overflow by concatenating a string in a loop until an error occurs.

methods.name: loadrep
methods.description: Creates a large string and loads it as a chunk, printing memory and error message.

methods.name: controlstruct
methods.description: Tests loading a very long control structure statement.

methods.name: manylines
methods.description: Loads a chunk with too many lines to test handling of line limits.

methods.name: hugeid
methods.description: Loads a chunk with an excessively long identifier.

methods.name: toomanyinst
methods.description: Loads a chunk with too many instructions.

methods.name: loadrepfunc
methods.description: Loads a function with many constants or instructions, expecting errors related to resource limits.

methods.name: toomanyconst
methods.description: Loads a function that has too many constants, testing limit handling.

methods.name: toomanystr
methods.description: Creates a very large string table to test memory restrictions.

methods.name: toomanyidx
methods.description: Fills a table with too many indices to test limits.
